result.summary: Found 1 visually broken content issue: an untranslated localization key is displayed as a section heading.

issues.description: The section heading below the "Fastest near you" carousel displays the raw localization key "home_feed.popular_title" instead of user-facing text.
issues.suggestion: Resolve the localization entry for this key and render the intended translated section title (for example, "Popular near you").
